title: ListServices discovery request
purpose: Provide a minimal, source-backed discovery frame with no payload to exercise encapsulation-command parsing independently of session or CPF handling.
expected_behavior: A compliant parser should accept the 24-byte encapsulation header, recognize ListServices, and either generate a normal service-list response or ignore it according to transport context; framing itself should be valid.
constraints_preserved: Length is 0, so the frame is exactly the 24-byte encapsulation header with no trailing payload.
Session Handle, Status, and Options are zeroed for a simple discovery request.
Sender Context is present as 8 bytes as required by the 24-byte header form.
issue_safety_notes: Not issue-guided; this seed is a simple valid discovery request and does not touch the vulnerable connection-manager parser path.
